balls.text: full on the stumps, Maharoof drives it down to long-on and charges off, the return throw is astray so he and Vettori can get back for the second
fuller outside off stump, slogged loosely over mid-on, runs hard for two

and thats dropped at third man! Easy catch goes down! Praveen keeps it short and it angles into Vettori as he makes room and uppercuts it down to Uthappa, who runs in and has plenty of time to take it but the ball slips out, the batsmen get a third and Praveen kicks the ground in disgust
nearly a yorker but too full, still its in the blockhole and Maharoof can only swing it away with one hand just wide of midwicket
length ball outside off stump, Maharoof clears the front leg and drills it back down to long-off, looks like four but suddenly Kallis slides across and cuts it off, good work
pitches on off stump, driven past extra cover and they run very hard
slower, on a length, Maharoof makes room and drives past extra cover
skips out again, connects on the flat ball and drives it down the ground, there's a misfield there and Maharoof can come back for the second
starts moving out, Roelof sees him and slows the pace so Maharoof has to hurry to adjust and pushes the ball back down the track
tossed up outside off stump, Vettori slog-sweeps past midwicket
flighted on middle and off, pushes it to the off side and runs
keeps it full and flat on middle and leg, Maharoof pushes at it and gets an inside edge to the leg side into the gap, they run hard and get two
good bowling, full and straight and Maharoof drives to extra cover

tries the cheeky shot and perishes this time! Praveen goes full outside off stump and Karthik gets across his stumps and top-edges the attempted paddle shot to Uthappa, running to his left at fine leg
still full and straight, no room on offer, Maharoof pushes it to long-on
full outside off stump, nearly the yorker, Karthik makes room and square-drives it to Pandey at point, who fumbles just a bit
pitches back of a length outside off and he forces it away past point
full and straight, Karthik goes across the sticks and plays the cheeky paddle but fine leg is up in the circle and does the fielding
flatter and fuller, middle and off, just pushes it to point and runs
gone now! Kumble flights it up nicely, gives it some air and that undoes Nagar, who is early into the big inside-out shot over cover and picks out Uthappa in the deep
slower one outside leg stump, bad ball, Nagar kneels down and attempts the paddle shot but cannot connect
slower ball slides down the pads and he brushes it for a single
short ball outside leg stump, Karthik swings and misses
too full and Karthik makes room to drive it inside out over cover
floats it up on a length and Nagar drives back over Kumble's head
short ball, Karthik goes back and across and ends up bunting the ball in the air but its safe and wide of midwicket and mid-on
connects and connects well for four, just meeting the ball on the full and punching sweetly past extra cover out to the deep, where the sweeper tumbles and cant stop it
fuller and flatter, comes forward and pushes the ball to cover
short and wide, spins away, he reaches out to cut but splices it in the air just wide of the man at point, who dives to his left but cannot get there in time
short ball, no turn, pulled out to Taylor at deep midwicket
lands it on a length, middle and off, pushed just wide of cover
floated up on the pads and Karthik flicks it past midwicket
full down leg stump, he goes for the flick but ball hits the pads
pitches on a length outside off stump, moves away, Nagar pushes at it the ball and drops it wide of backward point, who fumbles and allows the second run
slides down the pads and he easily tucks it out to the deep, runs hard and comes back for the second with an outstretched bat to make his ground
full and straight, makes room and drives it down to long-on for one
slides too far down the pads for a wide
lands on leg stump, Karthik pushes uneasily and gets one to cover
dropped! Kohli pitches it up, slides into leg stump, Nagar drives it back without much foot movement but Kohli cannot hold onto the sharp chance to his left
flatter and quicker, breaks away after pitching just around off stump, Nagar tries the cheeky dab but cannot connect and nearly ends up edging it, good bowling this
floater on middle and leg, Karthik gets over it and flicks it away
flatter ball and he works it off the pads for one
quicker ball on the stumps, googly, Nagar presses forward and gets hit in line but there's no reaction from the umpire, looks a very good shout but the umpire has some doubt
legbreak outside off stump, Nagar dabs it wide of point and sets off but no run there as Karthik sees the fielder is alert on the off side
pitches on leg stump, not much turn, Karthik works it off the pads
pitches on leg stump, straightens, and Nagar nervously defends
shorter and quicker outside off stump, Nagar allows it come on and then dabs the ball to cover, wants one but the fielder runs in and Karthik shoos Nagar back
straighter ball on leg stump, he eases back and works the ball away
too short and Karthik waits on the back foot, dragging it past midwicket
fuller this time and he drives into the gap at cover for one
pitches it up outside off stump, out the back of the hand, lands and turns away from the batsman who pushes and mises
floats it up and keeps it full, pitches on leg stump, Nagar drives it back and Kumble hurries to dive and field off his own bowling but still allows a single
slower ball on a length outside off stump, Karthik gets onto the front foot and turns  it wide of midwicket for a single
flat outside off stump, Nagar comes forward and pushes it to cover
yorked! Kumble pitches it up very straight, a quick yorker on middle stump, McDonald gets into terrible position and misses it completely, the ball crashes into off stump
fuller and flatter and Karthik collects on the full, clipping past midwicket
loops up the wrong 'un on off stump, McDonald drives and gets an inside edge to the leg side, so close to dragging that ball back onto his stumps
just a tad short and he drives off the back foot to extra cover
pushes it to cover for a single
good length, he gets forward and pushes it to the leg side
big wicket! Its the arm ball on a good length, AB looks to play it down but is late on the shot and the ball sneaks under the bat and disturbs the furniture
same stuff, gets forward and taps it to cover for a single
tossed up and he pushes it to cover and sets off
too short, lands on leg stump and Karthik is quick to see it, bunting it wide of midwicket out to Taylor in the deep
short and wide and slapped into the gap at cover for one
this one pitches outside leg stump, AB clips but Kohli is alert at midwicket
floats it on a length and AB pushes the ball to extra cover
flatter ball turns away off a short length, AB reaches out to cut but inside-edges it into the off side, really should have been slapped away for a couple
good ball, floated up on a length, AB drives past cover for a couple
slows it up to get AB reaching out to drive into the space at cover
slower ball drifting into leg stump draws an edge from AB, who looks to drive inside out but edges it wide of short third man, Kumble lumbers after it and slides in vain
flat, turns down the pads, glanced off the pads to PK at short fine leg
slower ball, wider and a touch shorter, AB drives out to Taylor in the deep
pitches on leg stump and breaks away, Karthik waits and then sees the turn before cocking the wrists to manufacture a single toward midwicket
good ball first up, quick and flat on middle and off and Karthik blocks
good ball, on a length, cramping Karthik, who uses soft hands to tap the ball in front of slip before running across for another smart single
fuller in length, the offcutter, AB presses forward to push the ball square on the off side and then just glances up at Karthik who is keen on the quick single
forces him onto the back foot now, dabbing it to midwicket for one
straight again and he uses his crease, going back and turning the ball into the spaces on the leg side, the man in the deep runs in to do the stopping
straighter ball on a length, Karthik turns it away just wide of midwicket
hits a length outside off and Karthik flirts and misses by a whisker
good ball, pitched up just outside off stump, some subtle movement, Karthik is committed to the front foot and then opens the face to nudge it down wide of gully
too wide so AB gets out to square-drive, doesn't connect well but does manage to pick the gap on the off side and manages a single
fuller, Karthik waits and at the last second pushes it to point for one
deft shot, reaches out and glides the wider ball to Kallis at third man
better length, fuller, change of pace, and AB defends to point
welcome! A tad too short on the stumps and AB gets up and swats it over midwicket, just not the ball to be bowling to this batsman

bad ball, bad shot! Kallis bowls it short and wide, a real half-tracker, Gambhir needlessly decides to try and jump up and uppercut it but makes horrible timing and slaps the ball straight to Taylor at cover-point, who takes his second catch of the day
fuller, slower, hint of movement, AB is already into the cover drive and hits it hard toward Akhil, who collects and returns a poor throw else the batsman was a goner
length ball outside leg stump, tucked off the pads for an easy single
shorter ball, too straight, AB knows fine leg is up and shuffles to brush the away but Praveen from square leg dives and saves three for his team
pitched up this time and he uses his feet nicely, just bringing the bat down in time to punch the ball past a diving mid-on for four, thats a good shot
slants into AB from off stump and he uses the angle and the pace to turn it wide of square leg, runs hard, and forces two men in the deep to really hustle to cut the ball off
back of a length outside off stump, AB gets across and gets the wrists into play, turning the ball to midwicket for a quick single, intelligent batting
short of a length just outside off stump and he dabs it to the off for one
gets room once more and dabs it fine but can't beat gully
and again, sublime timing from Gambhir, opening the face of the bat and steering this one wide of backward point, this time there's a man out in the deep to cut it off
fuller ball, Gambhir starts to push forward but then waits and ever so fluently guides the ball at the last second wide of the man at a wide slip, thats all class
starts off too short and Gambhir punches it easily into the gap at cover
smart running, just a tip and run, shorter ball and Gambhir allows it come onto him before tapping it in front of cover and setting off as AB responds easily
short of a length on off stump, he gets up and rolls it past square leg
he's not timed one ball today, has AB, bending his knee and square-driving at a good slower ball outside off stump and connecting with nothing but air
swing and a miss this time, went for the pull but the ball was too full
fuller, straighter, de Villiers on-drives very well to Roelof at mid-on
good length outside off stump, gentle stuff, de Villiers shapes to leave but then plays at it and runs it to backward point
searches for the yorker but doesn't get it right, ends up a low dipping full toss around off stump which Gambhir flicks with an inside edge through midwicket
imperious from Gambhir! Walks down the track and connects to the slower ball excellently, high elbow and all and thats an awesome straight six
there's the gentle offcutter, pitching outside and beating Gambhir
short and angling away, asking to be punished, Gambhir cuts hard but Kohli at backward point intercepts it very well
walks away from the stumps and flashes to one seaming away and misses, PK probably didn't see that so the delivery was a smart one anyways
good shot that, Praveen offers some room and Gambhir drives excellently, most importantly picking the space between three men square on the off side
fuller and now nipping back into AB, who hurries to defend to slip
plays and misses, AB tries to back-cut a length ball but is beaten
fuller length, pitching middle and going off, Gambhir pushes at it gently and runs it into the gap at backward point to get third man into play
short again, deja vu, slaps it hard but straight to Taylor there
short again, this time he connects but slaps it straight to cover
starts off short but the ball doesn't come on to Gambhir well as he reaches out to cut and chops the ball into the ground in front of point
fuller length and some seam movement, AB hurries to defend

another one down! Praveen's on a roll, this time bending his back and dragging the ball in short to suck Manhas into the pull shot, except he's nowhere in line to play that and gets a tame top edge that pops up the other way and Kallis, from second slip, dives forward to pluck the ball
fuller in length outside off stump, searches for swing, Manhas comes onto the front foot and pushes the ball solidly to cover
gone! Praveen gets Sehwag with an ordinary ball, its short of a length and slanting down leg stump but Sehwag just turns it off his pads to Taylor at square leg
good ball, short of a length on middle and leg, straightens, Sehwag gets in line and pushes the ball back to Praveen's right side and he does the fielding
starts off back of a length outside off stump and Gambhir pokes at it, safely getting the ball down into the gap between slip and backward point for a single
and thats the end of that! Kallis waits on the back foot and gently dabs the shorter ball to backward point and jogs through to seal victory with an over in hand
pitches short of a length outside leg stump, Boucher eases it off the back foot to midwicket and harries off, Sehwag eyes up the stumps and releases but misses
short ball angles across, Boucher swivels on the pull, ball brushes his shoulder en route to Karthik, Nehra shouts out an appeal but Ian Howell says sorry mate
slower ball, short outside leg stump, goes for a pull but cannot get bat on ball, it clips his pads and they steal a leg bye
yorker just outside off stump, squeezed away for one square one the off side, Nehra has overstepped so we have a free hit coming up
no need to run for those, full on the stumps and he gives himself some room and clips that over midwicket for four, all the fielder has to do it retrieve the ball
slower ball on a length, Boucher pushes it straight to point
spanked! Vettori offers room, Kallis gives himself more room and drives that fiercely past a diving cover and bisects two men in the deep
flat down leg stump, easy pickings and he flicks wide of midwicket, Boucher hustles for the second and is aided by a poor return from the deep
sees another short one and goes for the cut but cannot connect
uff what a shot! Kallis makes room and slices the ball hard and flat over extra cover and raises whats been an excellent half-century, well played Kallis
flatter arm ball, pitches middle and leg, makes room and pushes it
too short and thats hammered off the back foot past point for one
short of a length on middle and off, Boucher shuffles around and gets over the ball, placing it wide of point and cover, runs very hard to put pressure on Kallis and gets two
full on middle and leg, Kallis drives inside-out to mid-off for one
fuller, starts on leg and slants in, punched wide of mid-on for a couple
pitches it up, Kallis drives on the rise to cover where Vettori fumbles
pitches fuller outside leg stump, Kallis cannot connect on the flick
short outside leg stump and thats swatted off one leg past square leg
arm ball slides on and Kallis works it away wide of midwicket
just a wee bit short and Boucher pounces, cutting behind point
slower ball tossed up on a length, Boucher gets over it and defends
quicker and flatter and this time Kallis drives into the covers
bowling Harry! Top delivery, lovely loop and dip, pitches on off stump and spins away sharply from Kallis who again pushes forward and gets surprised
sharp turn and bounce beats Kallis, pushing down the wrong line
flat on middle and off and Kallis drives it past midwicket for one

looks for another six but picks out Vettori just inside the ropes at long-on! Nagar again tosses it up, a tad fuller this time and thats the major factor, because Taylor was down on one knee looking to lift that much squarer, just got under it and holed out to the deep
helloooooooooooo! Thats six more! Nagar tosses it up on a length, Taylor sizes it up as he gets across his stump and slogs that over deep square leg for maximum
see ya later! Short ball turns in and Taylor heaves it with the turn for six over square leg, massive hit and boy this kid can hit a long ball
tosses it up well outside off stump, Taylor gets down and tries to slog sweep that for six more, struck outside the line so cannot be given out
flights it up, Kallis waits for turn and runs the ball away for a single
has no one been watching Taylor bat all IPL? DO NOT bowl a full toss to him! Salvi errs and Taylor clubs the loose ball over midwicket for half a dozen
shot! Taylor shuffles across and slams the wide ball over extra cover, the ball just drops in front of the ropes
good length, Taylor presses forward and pushes it to extra cover
forces the ball to backward point, a fumble there, Kallis wasn't ready for the run and turns his back so Taylor walks back to the crease
a bit of room, Kallis is on the back foot and chops the cut to backward point where AB collects and fires in a throw, Kallis is gone for all money but the throw misses its mark
straighter one and Taylor brushes it off the pads to fine leg for one
slower ball, middle and off, driven back down the track for one more
on the stumps and Kallis turns it to short square leg for a single
shuffles across, Nagar fires it wide of off stump, Taylor slices it over cover on the bounce to the man on the ropes, well stopped so not much damage done
oversteps, good ball which Taylor plays to midwicket, free hit time
and he's got Dravid! Nagar strikes with one that's faster, shorter and turning back into Dravid who backs away to try and force it to the on side but instead chips it back to Nagar
throws it up short again and Kallis hits off the back foot to point
tosses it up too short, Dravid cuts but AB intercepts well at cover
straighter ball which is well tucked wide of short fine leg for one
this time he gets over the ball and glides it fine, Vettori is slow to get down and fumbles the ball while moving to his left and allows the extra run
pushes at one that jags back in off a shorter length, tries to run it to third man but is cramped and cannot get bat on ball
length ball slants down the stumps, Dravid is early into the on-drive and makes poor contact, the ball slides off his pads and runs back to McDonald
good shot, gets back and forces the ball into the gap at point, runs hard, Manhas does the mopping up in the deep
pitches on a length and thats worked just wide of midwicket
slightly short on the off, pushed through to deep cover to keep the strike
on middle and off, clipped away in front of square for a single
they're doing it easily here, bowled short on middle, pulled away wide of deep midwicket for a couple more
pushed through the off side wide of cover for one more
slightly short outside off, drops it in front of square leg for a single
shot! Bowled short and wide, rocks back, picks the length and hammers it between long-off and deep cover
loose shot to a slower one pitched on a length, Dravid loses a hand off the bat and looks on in fright as the ball balloons up and then lands safely in no mans land
a bit of room on offer and he square-drives through point for one
slides down the pads and he glances it fine, raising the 50-run stand
comes onto the front foot and manufactures another single
pitches on a length, middle and off, driven hard through midwicket for a single that brings up the 50 for Bangalore, its been slow coming
full and straight and driven past the man at cover for a single
a tad too short, Kallis gets back and punches through the covers
tossed up, he comes onto the front foot and drives straight
full and flat down leg stump, paddled away to short fine leg
fuller ball, looped up outside off, he drives and gets a single very fine
short, wide and cut away for a single

dropped but that would have taken some stopping ! Starts off short and wide and Kallis hammers it off the back foot, its in the air a fraction and nearly carries to AB at cover, who dives to his left and gets a finger on it
change of pace, length ball outside off and he steers it down for one
attempted yorker ends up a low full and Kallis flicks it off the lower part of the bat through a diving midwicket, runs hard and adds two to the total
good length outside off, Dravid gets forward and clips it past mid-on
shorter ball but Kallis uses the soft hands to guide it to third man
straighter one which he clips in front of his pads wide of square
too full outside off stump and Dravid doesn't disappoint with the drive, just leans into it and picks out the spot at extra cover, lovely shot from Dravid
fuller ball slants into Dravid, who makes a mess of the attempted on-drive, spooning it back to Maharoof's left, he can't get a hand on ball and it rolls to mid-off
slower ball on the pads, this time he clips it wide of Gambhir for a single
could have been four because its full on the pads, but Kallis doesn't connect too well and whats more Gambhir is alert and on the move at midwicket
length ball just outside off stump, good spot, Kallis pushes it to cover
a good straight drive to a full ball in the slot, Maharoof gets a finger on it, Vettori runs across from deep mid-off and cuts the ball off on the ropes
oh Kallis is playing a chancy innings here, this time the slower ball down the leg stump stops on him and he chips it over midwicket and it lands safely
again he comes out and looks to smash the ball over the covers but can only inside-edge it to midwicket, and ugly shot but Kallis will get back on strike
ah this one's not as well struck, he was on the rise to a fuller delivery and again wanted to go much straighter but scooped it to AB at cover, who returns a terrible throw
swings at the fuller one outside off stump and finds the gap between midwicket and mid-on, thats a shot he played well during his ODI career and the swipe works still
gives himself some room and takes on the shorter ball, thrashes it hard but backward point dives to his left to take some pace off the ball
this one darts back in to Dravid who makes room and stabs at the ball, getting a thick inside edge down toward short fine leg
full outside off stump, Dravid drives hard but mistimes it to point
good length on off stump and he dabs it to point and sets off
steps out this time, Maharoof keeps it down the pads and Kallis ends up turning it in the air safely wide of the man running across from midwicket
slower ball, pitched up, Kallis drives hard but again straight to point
back of a length outside off, Kallis forces it away to point this time
walks out of his crease and brushes a short ball off his pads to fine leg
short outside off stump and Dravid cuts it but two men converge to field
good length this time, not the ball to drive on the rise and Kallis ends up mistiming the shot to cover
full outside off, Kallis eases into a drive but can't perforate the covers
now he goes full outside off stump and Kallis kneels down to crunch the ball through the covers but isn't in good shape and misses out
first six of the innings! Salvi serves up on the pads and Kallis clips it in the air over deep square leg for a six, excellently picked up with awesome bat speed
holds back the length, Kallis again drives hard, Sehwag fields at mid-off
pitches it up on middle and leg, Kallis drives hard but Salvi intercepts
slower ball, change of pace surprises Dravid who is early into the shot, he tries to hold back and pull out but the ball takes the edge of the bat and rolls to backward point
good length ball gets Dravid reaching out to drive, a bit of bottom hand in the stroke and he ends up turning the ball back to Nehra who fields it
fuller, late movement, Dravid plays it out in front of the pad to midwicket
back of a length, pitches on leg stump, Dravid plays it back to Nehra
there's the spot, much better length and Dravid shoulders arms
well such stuff will get him back in form, its short and wide and slapped off the back foot into the gap between cover and point for four
full and pitching just down leg stump, Kallis again looks to flick that past midwicket but cannot connect, Salvi, Karthik and McDonald at slip beg but the umpire says no
too full, too straight, and Kallis clips the half-volley through midwicket
good drive from Kallis on the rise, but straight to the man again
good stuff, he's hit the right length and not offered any room, Kallis punches sweetly to the man at cover
full and straight, some shape, on-driven straight to midwicket
pitches full and gets some shape out, driven on the rise to cover
edged and gone! Nehra gets Uthappa with a full ball that angles wide and sucks him into a loose drive, Karthik takes the catch to his right, fumbles, but recovers in time
short ball outside leg stump, Uthappa flat-bats right to square leg
good ball, pitches and goes away, Kallis pushes at it and gets off the mark immediately as backward point dives and allows a run, looks like its Nagar
fuller on off stump, shape back in again, Uthappa clips the drive with a thin inside edge and gets off the mark
fuller, just, with a touch of shape back in, Uthappa drives to midwicket
starts off on the dime, a good length just around off and Uthappa defends
